title: Chrome window position mismatch: session restore override fix
desc: Two-layer fix for Chrome ignoring --window-position launch flag due to session restore override (Default/Preferences browser.window_placement rehydration). Pre-launch Preferences patch + post-timeout final reapply.
steps: Root cause: Chrome session restore (--restore-last-session / Default/Preferences browser.window_placement) overrides --window-position launch arg. Drift pattern: requested=(-2449,-362) vs actual=(-1169,357) drift 1280x719px.

Fix layer 1 (ChromeLauncher.SessionRestore.cs): Before launching Chrome, call SuppressSessionRestoreInPreferences(userDataDir) to patch Default/Preferences: set profile.exit_type=Normal, profile.exited_cleanly=true, delete browser.window_placement. This kills session restore at the source.

Fix layer 2 (CdpClient.WindowStabilize.cs): In SetWindowBoundsWaitStableAsync, on BOUNDS:TIMEOUT, send one final Browser.setWindowBounds with requested coords + short stability poll before surfacing BUG-AUTO suggest.
Verify: after fix, wkappbot ask gpt say hello completes in under 5s with no [CDP:BOUNDS:TIMEOUT] or AutoSuggestPositionMismatch in logs.

OWNERSHIP NOTE: Both fix layers live in the PRIVATE Core repo only -- SDK launcher has no direct control. ChromeLauncher.SessionRestore.cs and CdpClient.WindowStabilize.cs are in D:\GitHub\WKAppBot\csharp\src\WKAppBot.WebBot\. SDK side: invoke via standard cdp commands; fixes apply automatically at runtime. If position mismatch persists after v7.3 hot-swap, check cdp-mon for BOUNDS:TIMEOUT and verify Core is running v7.3+.

2026-05-18 verification: Chrome off-screen at -3840,-1079 (suggest ts=2026-05-11T01:12:24) investigated -- ClampBoundsToVisible (MonitorFromPoint-based) is already applied on ALL spawn paths including suggest-triggered CDP open. Bug was pre-existing and fixed by earlier DPI commit. No new code change needed.
2026-05-18 FIX 1 applied: WebCommands.Diagnostics.cs AutoSuggestPositionMismatch -- added drift<2px early-return to silence (0,0) false positives. Verified via wkedit.sh diff.
